title: E/11994/2016 — Hindustan Chemicals Company vs. Surat-ii
text:
In The Customs, Excise & Service Tax Appellate Tribunal
West Zonal Bench At Ahmedabad
E/ROM/10095/2018-SM
Appeal No.E/11994/2016-SM
M/s Hindustan Chemicals Company Appellant
Vs
C.C.E. & S.T. Surat-ii Respondent
Represented by:
For Appellant: Sh. Dhaval Shah (Advocate)
For Respondent: Sh. S.N. Gohil (A.R.)
CORAM:
HON’BLE DR. D.M. MISRA, MEMBER (JUDICIAL)
Date of Hearing/decision:26.03.2018
Misc Order No. M/ 10367 /2018
Per: Dr. D.M. Misra:
Heard both the sides.
2. This application is filed seeking rectification of the mistake
apparent on the face of the order Dated 17.08.2017.
3. The Ld. Advocate Sh. Dhaval Shah for the applicant submits that
in narrating the list of services mentioned at third line of the aforesaid
order ‘Marine Insurance Charges, GTA for Export Service and Effluent
Treatment Service’ and at fifth line the case laws, namely, VFC
Industries Pvt. Ltd. vs CCE Vadodara Order No. A/10953/2017 in
relation to Marine Insurance, Indian Farmers Fertilizers Co-op. Ltd. vs
Commr. Of Trade Tax, Lucknow 2015 (315) ELT 210 (All.) in relation to
Effluent Treatment Plant Service and GTA Service for Export of the
goods the case is covered in the case of Anar Chemicals Pvt. Ltd. vs CCE
Ahmedabad 2011 (24) STR 32 (Tri.Amd) even though argued and

2 | P age E / 11 99 4/2 01 6 -SM
dictated but in the types copy of the order, the same has not been found.
It is their request that the order may be rectified accordingly.
4. Ld. AR for the Revenue has no objection.
5. Consequently, in the order dt.17.8.2017, at fourth line, after the
word factory, it should be read as ‘Marine Insurance Charges, GTA for
Export Service and Effluent Treatment Service’ and at seventh line the
case laws, namely, VFC Industries Pvt. Ltd. vs CCE Vadodara Order No.
A/10953/2017 in relation to Marine Insurance, Indian Farmers
Fertilizers Co-op. Ltd. vs Commr. of Trade Tax, Lucknow 2015 (315) ELT
210 (All.) in relation to Effluent Treatment Plant Service and GTA Service
for Export of the goods the case is covered in the case of Anar Chemicals
Pvt. Ltd. vs CCE Ahmedabad 2011 (24) STR 32 (Tri.Amd), be added and
the Order is rectified accordingly.MA(ROM) alowed.
(Dictated and pronounced in the open court)
(Dr. D.M. Misra)
Member (Judicial)
Neha
